result:
Confirmed: this is a plain table of current flag config stating "50%" for `ai_issue_summary`, directly contradicted by `FEATURE_FLAG_DEFINITIONS` (`percent: 25`), and by every other doc in the corpus.

I've verified all four discrepancies against the actual source (`src/config/plan-limits.ts`, `src/config/feature-flags.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, `src/lib/errors.ts`) and cross-checked each against sibling docs that state the correct numbers, confirming each is an isolated error rather than a corpus-wide convention:

- **`docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md`** (REQ-134) — says free plan allows "3 projects"; `PLAN_LIMITS.free.projects` is `2` (and every other doc — ADR-010, `requirements/projects.md`, the pricing ops note — correctly says 2).
- **`docs/api/actions-flags.md`** — table says `ai_issue_summary` is a "percentage rollout (50%)"; `FEATURE_FLAG_DEFINITIONS.ai_issue_summary.strategy.percent` is `25` (matching every other doc, including this same file's own prose later on).
- **`docs/api/actions-comments.md`** — says the `comment:create` bucket is "capacity 60, refill 10/min"; `RATE_LIMIT_BUCKETS["comment:create"]` is `{ capacity: 60, refillPerMinute: 20 }` (matching ADR-011, the sizing ops note, and `service-comment.md`).
- **`docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md`** (DES-222) — asserts `PlanLimitError`, `RateLimitedError`, `UnauthorizedActionError`, `ForbiddenActionError`, `FeatureUnavailableError`, and `ActionNotFoundError` are "recognized" and mapped to their declared `ErrorCode`s. In reality `toAppError()` (`src/lib/errors.ts`) only has `instanceof` branches for the six *service*-layer errors; none of the action-layer classes are checked, so every one of them actually falls through to `internal_error`/500 instead of `unauthorized`/`forbidden`/`plan_limit_exceeded`/`rate_limited`/`not_found`.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md, docs/api/actions-flags.md, docs/api/actions-comments.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md
